# A Canadian company that buys US-listed shares and still holds them.
#
# The book holds no foreign currency at all, which is the point: shares are
# counted in units and priced, not converted, so they open no cost basis and
# keep GnuCash's own revaluation. The page states them under
# `unrealized_gains_other` with `unrealized_gains_fx` at 0.00, which a book
# holding both currency and shares cannot show apart.
#
# - 2025-08-01  10,000.00 CAD of opening capital.
# - 2025-08-15  12 NASDAQ:AMZN bought at 200.00 USD, the US dollar at 1.30,
#               so 3,120.00 CAD left the bank — 260.00 CAD a share.
#
# Prices, all at 12:00 UTC: NASDAQ:AMZN in USD 200 on 2025-08-15 and 280 on
# 2026-12-31; USD in CAD 1.30 on 2025-08-15 and 1.42 on 2026-12-31. The share
# is priced in US dollars and the book is kept in Canadian ones, so the report
# reaches its Canadian figure through both: 280.00 USD at 1.42 is 397.60 CAD.
#
# What this fixture produces as of 2026-12-31: 6,880.00 CAD in the bank and
# 12 AMZN worth 4,771.20 CAD, against 3,120.00 CAD of cost — so 1,651.20 CAD
# of unrealized gain, none of it foreign exchange.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity AMZN
	mnemonic: "AMZN"
	fullname: "Amazon.com Inc"
	namespace: "NASDAQ"
	fraction: 10000
2025-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2025-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2025-01-01 open Assets:AMZN
	type: "Stock"
	commodity.namespace: "NASDAQ"
	commodity.mnemonic: "AMZN"
2025-01-01 open Equity
	type: "Equity"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2025-01-01 open Equity:Opening balances
	type: "Equity"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

	time: "2026-12-31 12:00:00 +0000"

2025-08-01 * "Opening capital"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank 10000.00 CAD
	Equity:Opening balances -10000.00 CAD

2025-08-15 * "Buy 12 AMZN at 200.00 USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:AMZN 12 AMZN
		share_price: "260"
		value: "3120.00"
	Assets:Bank -3120.00 CAD
